description.en: The long (H) block of the 12 mm miniature linear guide: 27 mm wide, 45.4 mm long, with four M3 tapped holes on a 20 × 20 mm square on top. It mates its rail from below and a carriage plate or toolhead on top.
description.es: El bloque largo (H) de la guía lineal miniatura de 12 mm: 27 mm de ancho, 45.4 mm de largo, con cuatro barrenos roscados M3 en un cuadrado de 20 × 20 mm en la parte superior. Se une a su riel por abajo y a una placa de carro o un cabezal por arriba.
description.fr: Le patin long (H) du guidage linéaire miniature de 12 mm : 27 mm de large, 45,4 mm de long, avec quatre trous taraudés M3 sur un carré de 20 × 20 mm sur le dessus. Il s'accouple à son rail par-dessous et à une plaque de chariot ou une tête par-dessus.
description.pt: O bloco longo (H) da guia linear miniatura de 12 mm: 27 mm de largura, 45,4 mm de comprimento, com quatro furos roscados M3 num quadrado de 20 × 20 mm em cima. Acopla ao trilho por baixo e a uma placa de carro ou cabeça por cima.

sources.title: HIWIN linear guideways MG series — dimensions for MGN/MGW

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the top mounting face (the face with the four M3 holes). +z up, out of that face; +x along the rail (the block's long direction); +y across. The rail's top face lies 5 mm below the top face (H 13 − rail height 8), so the rail interface sits at z = −5.

assembly_height.note: H: rail bottom to block top

interfaces.note: Female: tapped holes receive the fastener's thread. Symmetry 4: the 20 × 20 mm pattern is square.
Female: the block receives the rail. z = −5 is derived from H 13 − HR 8.
